entries.28906692b5a6aa88: A single-segment business that develops graphics IP cores for rendering fine images and IP cores for artificial intelligence, licenses them to semiconductor manufacturers and end-product manufacturers, sells LSI products incorporating its own IP cores, and conducts contract development to support customers' product development. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,432 million; its main locations are its head office (Nakano-ku, Tokyo) and the Tokyo Robotics Innovation Center (Ota-ku, Tokyo).

entries.711c8cc4883f1850: A business that sells LSI products incorporating its own IP cores, with manufacturing outsourced to semiconductor manufacturers. Mass shipments of the image processing semiconductor 'RS1' for amusement equipment are central, and it also handles a vision system for collaborative robots from U.S.-based Cambrian, camera modules for mass-produced drones, FA products, and a development kit for the edge AI semiconductor 'Di1'. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,218 million.

entries.c2a78e0b66e99c80: A business that offers design services integrating its own IP cores to study and optimize a customer's entire SoC system, and contract development of algorithms, software and hardware tailored to customers' products based on GPU, vision and AI technologies. It conducts contract development for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, safe-driving assistance, and autonomous mobile robots (AMR), among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥74 million.
